hero_section.hero-description_label: A passion for web design, programming and constantly learning about new technologies.

about_section.first-paragraph: I am a full-stack developer who is passionate about web development and keen to establish myself in the software industry.
about_section.second-paragraph: I specialize in building performant, well-architected web applications from conception to deployment — from polished React interfaces to scalable APIs and relational databases. I care deeply about code quality, developer experience, and shipping things that actually work.
about_section.third-paragraph: Currently, I am seeking to join a dynamic technical team where I can contribute my continuous learning ability and continue to grow professionally.
about_section.freelance_paragraph: Building custom web applications and websites for clients.Freelance projects has taught me the importance of good planning, enabling me to identify all the processes required to create a solution tailored to each client's needs.
about_section.dev_paragraph: Management and maintenance of development and production web/mail servers, DNS config, domain transfers and project deployment. SEO and Performance + Plugins and custom front-end development for WordPress.
about_section.it_paragraph: Management and maintenance of an IoT sensor monitoring platform based on the TIG stack (Telegraf, InfluxDB and Grafana). Provided technical support in a SaaS environment to ensure correct visualization and availability of data dashboards for clients.
